entry_contract: Continue from 36 Thousand Needles & Desolace, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in Dustwallow Marsh with Mudcrush Durtfeet. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from Thousand Needles to Dustwallow Marsh. Use a known flight path when it saves time; otherwise follow roads and zone connections. Continue to [G35.15,38.26 Dustwallow Marsh]. [O]
Before you begin: travel to Dustwallow Marsh and meet the first quest giver at [G35.15,38.26 Dustwallow Marsh]. Leave at least two quest-log slots open. [O]
